title: Belmont Hotel Manila spotlights Batangas cuisine with 2 new dishes
summary: Belmont Hotel Manila is highlighting the culinary traditions of Batangas with two Filipino-inspired dishes created by chefs Grant Zuniga and Aaron Valeroso as part of its 11th anniversary celebration.
